CLAT Admission Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) has released the result for the CLAT BA/ LLB/ and LLM UG/ PG Course Admission 2026 on the official website of the CLAT recently. Online registration process for CLAT Admission Online Form 2026 will start from 03 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 31 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for CLAT Admission Online Form 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 August 2026
  • Last Date : 31 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 06 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result Date : will be updated here soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC Candidates : Rs. 4000/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 3500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is CLAT Admission Online Form 2026?

CLAT Admission Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 31 October 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://consortiumofnlus.ac.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
